description: Create and maintain stable cross-system links, and detect/repair drift, between Notion and Linear.

evals.name: Link a Notion record to a Linear record
evals.prompt: Link this Notion idea to the Linear issue it became.
evals.expected_output: Records the link as the reciprocal notion-link/linear-link entity fields on each side's own record, not a content mirror and not stored in the transition contract itself.

evals.name: Check for drift
evals.prompt: Check for drift between Notion and Linear on the CSV export work.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the result as exactly one of the six defined drift states (never leaves it ambiguous without an Unknown classification), and does not propose resolving by newest timestamp.

evals.name: Repair a broken link
evals.prompt: Linear issue AND-7's notion-link field points to a Notion page ID that now returns "Page not found". Repair this broken link.
evals.expected_output: Classifies this as a Broken link per the six defined drift states, re-resolves by stable ID within the owning system (Notion) before concluding the target record was deleted rather than guessing from a content/title search, and does not silently write a repair (via a guessed replacement or newest-timestamp resolution) without surfacing the uncertainty to the user.
